name: Solitaire
description: Classic Klondike solitaire made for touch: tap a card and it jumps where it fits.
prompt: Klondike solitaire for phones where tapping a card moves it to the best place, with draw one or draw three, undo, hints, auto-finish, a win animation and the game saved.
author: gonzaroman
